catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types

objects.name: Shattered Earth influence atlas
objects.description: Original world geography as the exact visual base; eight house map colours and schematic overlays after page25. This is a map, not a battle scene. Preserve continents, floating fragments and camera projection.
constraints: Use map/UI colours rather than banner material colours. No invented ninth duchy or precise city coordinates.
Keep eight home regions and add local changes near Auric Reach. Never recolour all Glassmere/Ironveil or all Auric Reach as Rovan’s territory.

world_constraints: One image per request; no multi-panel collage or embedded borders.
Compose for the fixed holder. Do not letterbox or paste the old wide image.
Preserve character faces, outfits, heraldry, weapons, metal colours and scene counts.
Keep essential faces, bodies and weapons inside the visible crop-safe area and outside lettering zones.
No unsupported new lore, extra Type C suits, extra capital ships or invented character names.

Floating-island backgrounds must have deliberately varied asymmetric silhouettes, geology, heights, scale and land use. Mix broad fractured mesas, thin tilted slabs, split rock spires and bare rubble, with open sky between them. Some fragments are uninhabited or vegetated; not every island carries an identical castle. Never tile, mirror or repeat the same inverted-cone island/city silhouette. Preserve a named location’s defining geography when changing camera angle.

Atlas plate only. Preserve original world-map geography and eight duchies. Use schematic influence and a readable local-change legend, not surveyed borders. No invented precise city coordinates or full-duchy conquests.
Cartographic plate: eight home regions plus three numbered LOCAL change keys. Preserve the source atlas geography.
Map/UI colours, not flags. No people, ships, uniforms, extra duchies, precise city coordinates or surveyed borders.
Full map must fit uncropped within the portrait page, with legible legend and narration.

All airborne vessels are rigid mechanical bronze/metal Zeppelin-like ships. ANY wooden sailing boats or cloth sails seen in an old scene reference are obsolete errors: REPLACE them with small bronze Zeppelin commuter hulls, keeping background positions.

reference_precedence: Canonical banner reference for emblem geometry and colour placement

prompt: Edit this completed influence atlas. Preserve ALL EXACT words, all EIGHT duchy names, geographic arrangement, home region colours, the three local influence marks and numbered legend. Recompose it into a TALL PORTRAIT 3:4 canvas, suitable for a 952x1268 comic holder, so the WHOLE world map fits without cropping. All map landmasses, ALL eight labels, title, legend and closing narration must be within the CENTRAL 76 PERCENT of canvas WIDTH (x=12% to88%), leaving expendable dark teal sky or bronze framing at outer sides. In particular move/rewrap the ENTIRE bottom narration into a narrower CREAM box within x12%..88%, with comfortable left/right margins, using THREE OR FOUR lines if needed. Exact bottom text: Rovan held Oram, New Frontier and the recovered moorings. The mining approaches remained disputed. These are regions of influence, not surveyed borders. Do NOT shorten, omit or alter any text. Keep title: Influence after the first campaigns. Keep map labels Veymarch, Auric Reach, Ironveil, Glassmere, Stormholt, Emberfall, Verdant Crown, Pale Meridian. Keep all three numbered legend entries and Other four duchies unchanged. Remove ALL three decorative red/gold star banners outside the map, replacing them with plain bronze framing or dark teal sky with NO flags or stars. Remove the tiny decorative airships above the map. Do not remove actual influence colours or map islands. Map and legend must be clear, full and readable; do not invent any new region or colour. Main change: compose full atlas/text safely for fixed portrait holder. Background outside central76percent may be cropped, but no important text or map content.
